title: "Spellbook"

---

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**⭐ = Prepared / Always Prepared** · **C** = Concentration · **R** = Ritual · *Mage Armor struck through — medium armor is better*
:::

<p class="sb-section-label">Cantrips</p>

```{=html}
<div class="sb-grid">

  <!-- Fire Bolt -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-evocation">
      <span class="sb-name">Fire Bolt</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Evocation Cantrip · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">120 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range. Make a <b>ranged spell attack</b> against the target. On a hit, the target takes <b>1d10 fire damage</b>. A flammable object hit by this spell ignites if it isn't being worn or carried.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Cantrip Upgrade:</strong> 2d10 at level 5 · 3d10 at level 11 · 4d10 at level 17</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Attack: +7</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Poison Spray -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-necromancy">
      <span class="sb-name">Poison Spray</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Necromancy Cantrip · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">10 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas. The creature must succeed on a <b>CON saving throw (DC 15)</b> or take <b>1d12 poison damage</b>.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Cantrip Upgrade:</strong> 2d12 at level 5 · 3d12 at level 11 · 4d12 at level 17</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook</div>
  </div>

  <!-- True Strike -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-evocation">
      <span class="sb-name">True Strike <em style="font-size:.8rem;opacity:.85">(2024)</em></span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Evocation Cantrip · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Self (melee/ranged)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">S (no V!)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>Guided by a flash of magical insight, you make one attack with a weapon or unarmed strike — or one <b>melee or ranged spell attack</b>. You can use your <b>spellcasting ability (INT)</b> instead of STR or DEX for the attack and damage rolls. On a hit, the target takes <b>1d6 + INT modifier radiant damage</b>.</p>
      <p><em>Unlike the 2014 version, this is an attack cantrip — no more forfeiting your action to gain advantage.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Cantrip Upgrade:</strong> 2d6 at level 5 · 3d6 at level 11 · 4d6 at level 17</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Attack: +7 (INT)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Guidance -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-divination">
      <span class="sb-name">Guidance</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Divination Cantrip · Cleric (Acolyte background)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Concentration, 1 min</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a <b>d4</b> and add the number rolled to one <b>ability check</b> of its choice. The creature can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Acolyte background (Cleric cantrip)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Thaumaturgy -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-transmutation">
      <span class="sb-name">Thaumaturgy</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Transmutation Cantrip · Cleric (Acolyte background)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">30 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Up to 1 minute</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power. Choose one of the following effects:</p>
      <p>• Your voice booms up to <b>3× louder</b> for 1 minute.<br>
      • You cause <b>flames to flicker, brighten, dim, or change colour</b> for 1 minute.<br>
      • You cause harmless <b>tremors</b> in the ground for 1 minute.<br>
      • You create an <b>instantaneous sound</b> that originates from a point you choose within range.<br>
      • You <b>instantaneously cause an unlocked door or window to fly open or slam shut</b>.<br>
      • You alter the appearance of <b>your eyes</b> for 1 minute.</p>
      <p>Up to <b>three</b> of these effects can be active at a time.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Acolyte background (Cleric cantrip)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Minor Illusion -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-illusion">
      <span class="sb-name">Minor Illusion ⭐</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Illusion Cantrip · Wizard · Illusionist feature</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag prepared">Always Prepared</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">30 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">S, M (fleece)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 minute</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>Create a <b>sound</b> or an <b>image</b> of an object within range that lasts for the duration.</p>
      <p><b>Sound:</b> Your choice of a creature's voice, a distinct voice, animal sounds, musical instruments — originating from any point within range. Volume can be a whisper or a scream.</p>
      <p><b>Image:</b> An object no larger than a <b>5-foot cube</b>. No sound, smell, texture, or temperature. A creature that interacts with it can make an <b>Investigation check vs. DC 15</b> to disbelieve.</p>
      <p>⭐ <b>Improved Minor Illusion (Illusionist, level 2):</b> You can create both a sound <em>and</em> an image simultaneously with a single casting.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Illusionist subclass feature</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Toll the Dead -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-necromancy">
      <span class="sb-name">Toll the Dead</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Necromancy Cantrip · Magic Initiate (Cleric)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment. The target must succeed on a <b>WIS saving throw (DC 15)</b> or take necrotic damage.</p>
      <p>The target takes <b>1d8</b> necrotic damage. If the target is <b>missing any of its Hit Points</b>, it instead takes <b>1d12</b> necrotic damage.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Cantrip Upgrade:</strong> 2d8/2d12 at level 5 · 3d8/3d12 at level 11 · 4d8/4d12 at level 17</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Magic Initiate feat (Cleric)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Starry Wisp -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-evocation">
      <span class="sb-name">Starry Wisp</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Evocation Cantrip · Magic Initiate (Cleric)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You launch a mote of light at one creature or object within range. Make a <b>ranged spell attack</b> against the target. On a hit, the target takes <b>1d8 radiant damage</b>, and until the end of your next turn, it emits <b>dim light in a 10-foot radius</b> and <b>can't benefit from the Invisible condition</b>.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Cantrip Upgrade:</strong> 2d8 at level 5 · 3d8 at level 11 · 4d8 at level 17</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Magic Initiate feat (Cleric) · Attack: +7</div>
  </div>

</div>
```

<p class="sb-section-label">Level 1 Spells</p>

```{=html}
<div class="sb-grid">

  <!-- Command -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-enchantment">
      <span class="sb-name">Command</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Enchantment · 1st Level · Cleric (Acolyte)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 round</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a <b>WIS saving throw (DC 15)</b> or follow the command on its next turn.</p>
      <p>The spell has no effect if the target is Undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.</p>
      <p><b>Example commands:</b> <em>Approach</em> (move toward you), <em>Drop</em> (drops held items), <em>Flee</em> (move away from you), <em>Grovel</em> (falls prone and ends turn), <em>Halt</em> (doesn't move, no actions/reactions).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> Target one additional creature for each slot level above 1st.</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Acolyte background (Cleric spell) · Uses 1st-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Magic Missile -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-evocation">
      <span class="sb-name">Magic Missile</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Evocation · 1st Level · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">120 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You create three <b>glowing darts of magical force</b>. Each dart unerringly strikes a target of your choice — <b>no attack roll</b>. Each dart deals <b>1d4 + 1 force damage</b>. You can split them between any number of targets.</p>
      <p><em>Each dart is a separate instance of damage, which matters for effects that trigger on being hit.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> +1 dart per slot level above 1st (4 darts @ 2nd · 5 @ 3rd…)</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Uses 1st-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Mage Armor (obsolete) -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-abjuration">
      <span class="sb-name" style="text-decoration:line-through;opacity:.65">Mage Armor</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Abjuration · 1st Level · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag obsolete">Superseded by medium armor</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (leather)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">8 hours</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor. A protective magical force surrounds it, making its base AC equal to <b>13 + DEX modifier</b> until the spell ends. The spell ends if the target dons armor.</p>
      <p><em>⚠ No longer useful — you wear medium armor (better AC) as a Ranger.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Still in spellbook but not prepared</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Grease -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-conjuration">
      <span class="sb-name">Grease</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Conjuration · 1st Level · Magic Initiate (Cleric)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (butter)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 minute</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>Slick grease covers the ground in a <b>10-foot square</b> centred on a point within range. That area becomes <b>difficult terrain</b> for the duration.</p>
      <p>When the grease appears, each creature standing in its area must succeed on a <b>DEX saving throw (DC 15)</b> or have the <b>Prone condition</b>. A creature that enters the area or ends its turn there must also succeed or fall Prone.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Magic Initiate feat (Cleric) · Uses 1st-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Unseen Servant -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-conjuration">
      <span class="sb-name">Unseen Servant</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Conjuration · 1st Level · Wizard · Ritual</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag ritual">Ritual</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action / Ritual +10 min</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (string)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>This spell creates an <b>invisible, mindless, shapeless force</b> that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. It has <b>STR 2</b>, <b>AC 10</b>, and <b>1 Hit Point</b>. It disappears if reduced to 0 HP.</p>
      <p>As a <b>Bonus Action</b>, you mentally command the servant to move up to 15 ft and interact with an object. It can open/close doors, carry up to <b>25 lbs</b>, clean, pour drinks, hold torches, and similar tasks — but cannot attack.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Cast as ritual (no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Find Familiar -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-conjuration">
      <span class="sb-name">Find Familiar</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Conjuration · 1st Level · Wizard · Ritual</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag ritual">Ritual</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 hour (ritual)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">10 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (10 gp consumed)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Until dismissed</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You gain the service of a <b>familiar</b>, a spirit that takes an animal form of your choice: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel.</p>
      <p>As an <b>Action</b>, you can see through the familiar's eyes and hear through its ears until the start of your next turn. You can communicate telepathically with it within 100 ft.</p>
      <p>When you cast a spell with a <b>touch range</b>, your familiar can deliver it as if it cast the spell, as long as it is within 100 ft of you.</p>
      <p>If the familiar drops to 0 HP, it disappears. You can resummon it by recasting the spell (consumes 10 gp again).</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Cast as ritual (no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Comprehend Languages -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-divination">
      <span class="sb-name">Comprehend Languages</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Divination · 1st Level · Wizard · Ritual</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag ritual">Ritual</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action / Ritual +10 min</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Self</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (soot, salt)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any <b>spoken language</b> that you hear. You also understand any <b>written language</b> that you see, but you must be touching the surface on which the words are written. It takes about 1 minute to read one page of text.</p>
      <p>This spell doesn't decode secret messages or glyphs that aren't part of a written language.</p>
      <p><em>Does not grant the ability to speak or write the language.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Cast as ritual (no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Tenser's Floating Disk -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-conjuration">
      <span class="sb-name">Tenser's Floating Disk</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Conjuration · 1st Level · Wizard · Ritual</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag ritual">Ritual</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action / Ritual +10 min</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">30 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (mercury drop)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, <b>3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick</b>, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within range. The disk persists for the duration and can hold up to <b>500 pounds</b>.</p>
      <p>If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends. The disk remains level even on inclined surfaces.</p>
      <p>If you move more than <b>20 feet away</b> from it, the disk follows you. If you are ever more than <b>100 feet away</b> from it, the spell ends.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Cast as ritual (no slot needed)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Silent Image -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-illusion">
      <span class="sb-name">Silent Image</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Illusion · 1st Level · Wizard (costs 2nd-level slot)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (fleece)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Concentration, 10 min</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a <b>15-foot cube</b>. The image appears at a spot within range and lasts for the duration. The image is purely visual — it has <b>no sound, smell, or other sensory effects</b>.</p>
      <p>As an <b>Action</b>, you can cause the image to move to any spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image.</p>
      <p>Physical interaction reveals the image as an illusion. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine it is illusory with a successful <b>Investigation check (DC 15)</b>.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Slot: 2nd level (Tiberius preference)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Silvery Barbs -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-enchantment">
      <span class="sb-name">Silvery Barbs</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Enchantment · 1st Level · Wizard (costs 2nd-level slot)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag react">Reaction</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Reaction*</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">60 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p><em>*Trigger: a creature within 60 ft succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.</em></p>
      <p>You unleash a barrage of needle-like shards of silver that force the triggering creature to <b>reroll the d20 and use the lower roll</b>, potentially turning the success into a failure.</p>
      <p>You can also choose a <b>different creature you can see</b> within range (not the triggering creature). That creature gains <b>advantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw</b> it makes within 1 minute. A creature can have this benefit only once per casting.</p>
      <p><em>One of the strongest reaction spells in the game — can deny a critical hit or a passed saving throw.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Slot: 2nd level (Tiberius preference)</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Color Spray -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-illusion">
      <span class="sb-name">Color Spray ⭐</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Illusion · 1st Level · Wizard · Prepared</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag prepared">Prepared</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Self (15-ft cone)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (sand/powder)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 round</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>A dazzling array of flashing, coloured light springs from your hand. Roll <b>6d10</b>; the total is how many Hit Points of creatures this spell can affect. Starting with the creature that has the lowest current HP, each creature affected by this spell is <b>Blinded</b> until the end of your next turn.</p>
      <p>Creatures in the area are affected in ascending order of their current Hit Points. Subtract each creature's Hit Points from the total before moving to the next. A creature's HP must be equal to or less than the remaining total for the creature to be affected.</p>
      <p><em>Note: Can be cast at 1st or 2nd slot too — just affects fewer HP worth of creatures (no 3rd slot yet).</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> Roll an additional 2d10 for each slot level above 1st.</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Can use any slot level (planned for 3rd when available)</div>
  </div>

</div>
```

<p class="sb-section-label">Level 2 Spells</p>

```{=html}
<div class="sb-grid">

  <!-- Magic Weapon -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-transmutation">
      <span class="sb-name">Magic Weapon</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Transmutation · 2nd Level · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag conc">C</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Bonus Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Concentration, 1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a <b>+1 bonus</b> to attack rolls and damage rolls.</p>
      <p>This means it <b>bypasses resistance and immunity</b> to damage from nonmagical attacks — crucial against constructs, undead, and similar creatures.</p>
      <p><em>Great on your Warhammer or Light Crossbow before a fight you know involves resistant creatures.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> +2 bonus with a 4th-level slot · +3 bonus with a 6th-level slot</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Uses 2nd-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Nystul's Magic Aura -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-illusion">
      <span class="sb-name">Nystul's Magic Aura</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Illusion · 2nd Level · Wizard (Illusionist)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (silk square)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">24 hours</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You place an illusion on a creature or object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object not carried or worn by another creature.</p>
      <p>Choose one or both of the following effects when you cast the spell:</p>
      <p><b>False Aura:</b> You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects that detect magical auras, such as <em>Detect Magic</em>. You can make a nonmagical object appear magical, a magical object appear nonmagical, or change the object's magical aura to appear as a different school of magic you choose.</p>
      <p><b>Mask:</b> You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects that detect creature types, such as a paladin's Divine Sense. You choose a creature type and other spells treat the target as if it were that type.</p>
      <p>If you cast this spell on the same creature or object every day for 30 days, placing the same effect on it each time, the illusion lasts until it is dispelled.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook (Illusionist) · Uses 2nd-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Invisibility -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-illusion">
      <span class="sb-name">Invisibility ⭐</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Illusion · 2nd Level · Wizard (Illusionist)</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag conc">C</span><span class="sb-tag prepared">Prepared</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (eyelash in gum arabic)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Concentration, 1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>A creature you touch becomes <b>Invisible</b> until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is Invisible as long as it is on the target's person.</p>
      <p>The spell ends for a target that makes an <b>attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell</b>.</p>
      <p><em>⭐ War Caster: maintain concentration with Advantage on CON saves when taking damage.</em></p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook (Illusionist) · Uses 2nd-level slot</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Rope Trick -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-transmutation">
      <span class="sb-name">Rope Trick</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Transmutation · 2nd Level · Wizard</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S, M (powdered corn)</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope then rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end of the rope, an <b>invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space</b> that lasts until the spell ends.</p>
      <p>The space can hold as many as <b>eight Medium or smaller creatures</b>. Attacks and spells cannot pass through the entrance into or out of the extradimensional space, but those inside can see through the entrance as if looking through a 3-foot-by-5-foot window centered on the rope.</p>
      <p>Anything inside the space drops out when the spell ends. The rope can be picked up or moved, and if pulled into the space, it stays there. The entrance is <b>invisible from outside</b>.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Wizard spellbook · Uses 2nd-level slot</div>
  </div>

</div>
```

<p class="sb-section-label">Ranger Spells</p>

```{=html}
<div class="sb-grid">

  <!-- Hunter's Mark -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-divination">
      <span class="sb-name">Hunter's Mark ⭐</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Divination · 1st Level · Ranger · Always Prepared</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag conc">C</span><span class="sb-tag prepared">Always Prepared</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Bonus Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">90 ft</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Concentration, 1 hour</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra <b>1d6 damage</b> to the target whenever you hit it with an attack roll. Also, if the target dies before this spell ends, you can use a <b>Bonus Action</b> to mark a new creature.</p>
      <p>⭐ <b>Favored Enemy (Hobgoblin):</b> Hunter's Mark is always prepared and you can cast it <b>twice per day without expending a spell slot</b>. Both uses are regained on a Long Rest.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> 3rd-level slot → Concentration up to 8 hours · 5th-level slot → Concentration up to 24 hours</div>
    <div class="sb-footer">Ranger spell · WIS DC 11 · Favored Enemy: 2× free/day</div>
  </div>

  <!-- Cure Wounds -->
  <div class="sb-card">
    <div class="sb-head sbh-abjuration">
      <span class="sb-name">Cure Wounds ⭐</span>
      <span class="sb-sublabel">Abjuration · 1st Level · Ranger · Prepared</span>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-tags"><span class="sb-tag prepared">Prepared</span></div>
    <div class="sb-stats-grid">
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Casting Time</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Action</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Range</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Touch</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Components</span><span class="sb-stat-val">V, S</span></div>
      <div class="sb-stat"><span class="sb-stat-lbl">Duration</span><span class="sb-stat-val">Instantaneous</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-body">
      <p>A creature you touch regains a number of Hit Points equal to <b>2d8 + your WIS modifier</b>.</p>
      <p>This spell has no effect on Undead or Constructs.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sb-upcast"><strong>Higher Slots:</strong> +2d8 for each slot level above 1st (4d8+WIS @ 2nd · 6d8+WIS @ 3rd…)</div>

</div>
```
